stack.summary: Flutter with Clean Architecture per feature. A feature owns `presentation/`, `domain/` and `data/`, its routes and its endpoint paths; dependencies point inward, so `domain/` imports neither Dio nor a DTO. Every dependency is a generated Riverpod provider, every seam returns `Either<Failure, T>` instead of throwing, and `bootstrap/` is the one composition root where adapters are chosen per flavor.
layout: lib/
├── main.dart                 # runZonedGuarded → flavor → bootstrap
├── app.dart                  # MaterialApp.router: theme, locale, router
├── flavors.dart              # Flavor enum and the accessor the app reads
├── bootstrap/                # ProviderContainer, SDK init, adapter selection
├── core/
│   ├── configurations/       # per-flavor configuration and its accessor
│   ├── di/                   # composition-root providers and flavor overrides
│   ├── error/                # Failure, capture, guards, response policy
│   ├── navigation/           # AppRouter, FeatureRouteSet, route gating
│   ├── network/              # Dio clients, interceptors, call adapter
│   ├── observability/        # AnalyticsSink, CrashReporter, AppLogger ports
│   ├── platform/             # narrow ports over device capabilities
│   └── storage/              # secure storage, preferences, local database
├── features/<feature>/
│   ├── data/                 # api, dto, mappers, repository impls
│   ├── domain/               # entities, repository interfaces, modules
│   ├── presentation/         # pages, widgets, view models
│   ├── <feature>_routes.dart # paths and GoRoutes this feature owns
│   └── <feature>_urls.dart   # endpoint paths this feature calls
└── shared/                   # theme tokens, reusable widgets, extensions
test/                         # mirrors lib/, one folder per feature
conventions: **Layer direction.** `presentation → domain → data ports`, with data implementations depending inward on domain contracts. A file under `domain/` that imports `dio`, a DTO or a Flutter widget is in the wrong layer.

**Files are snake_case, types are UpperCamelCase, and the file is named after its type**: `item_repository.dart` holds `ItemRepository`. A provider file is `<thing>_provider.dart` beside the implementation it builds.
**Generated output is machine-owned.** Never hand-edit `*.g.dart` or `*.freezed.dart`; edit the annotated source and run the `generate` check.
**A feature is vertical.** New behaviour adds a folder under `features/`, not a layer under `core/`. Something lands in `core/` only once two features need it.
**Failures are values.** A seam captures the exception and returns `Either<Failure, T>`; `Right` is success. Nothing above the seam catches, and nothing below it throws across a layer boundary.
**One owner per lifecycle.** App state is a module with a snapshot and a replaying stream; page behaviour is an auto-dispose ViewModel; widgets own only controllers and transient visuals.
